device_entry.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
tags: 基因编辑、分子生物学与育种
device_entry.description: BioShake是一种用于微孔板样品处理的台式加热振荡设备，可对板内样品进行控温与振荡混匀，并支持夹板锁定。常用于分子生物学与生化实验中的孵育、溶解、反应混合和样品预处理。
device_entry.description_en: BioShake is a benchtop microplate heater shaker for temperature-controlled incubation and shaking/mixing of plate-based samples, with plate locking support. It is commonly used in molecular biology and biochemistry workflows for incubation, dissolution, reaction mixing, and sample preparation.
